introHtml: Beacon safety work lights deliver high-visibility warning signals for construction zones, roadside assistance, and warehouse operations. Unlike standard work lights, beacon models feature rotating or flashing LED lamps that grab attention from a distance. Customize with your company logo or safety message to reinforce branding while meeting OSHA compliance. Ideal for safety managers equipping crews with dependable, weather-resistant lighting.
